title: Implement admin HTTP endpoint: /health, /stats, /log-tip, /peers
description:
Implement a minimal HTTP server (axum or hyper) on the admin port exposing: GET /health (200 OK + JSON {status:'ok', uptime_secs}), GET /stats (JSON: article counts, group counts, pinned count, peer count), GET /log-tip?group=<name> (JSON: current tip CID and entry count for the named group), GET /peers (JSON array of connected peer IDs and their addresses). Artifact: transit/src/admin.rs and reader/src/admin.rs.

Acceptance:
- /health returns 200 within 100ms under normal load
- /stats returns correct counts matching SQLite state
- /log-tip returns 404 for unknown group, 200 with tip data for known group
- /peers returns correct peer list (tested in two-node integration test)
- Admin port is separate from the NNTP port (different config key)
